blocks.content: Course: Build your First Web App with React
Our entry card needs two modes:

items: View: Shows title, content, and buttons
Edit: Shows inputs and Save/Cancel buttons.

blocks.content: We'll start by adding a single piece of local state named isEditing to track which mode the card is in.
Here, isEditing starts as false (view mode). When the user clicks Edit it will become true, switching the card to edit mode.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
